description: One UK financial year, with the UK company financial statements decoded from the iXBRL accounts filed at Companies House: balance sheet (fixed and current assets, stocks, debtors, cash, creditors split by maturity, provisions, net assets, equity), average employees, and the profit and loss account when filed (turnover, operating, pre-tax and net result; most small companies file a balance sheet only), plus prior-year comparatives as published. Null = not published, never zero. Balance-sheet date comes from list_uk_company_accounts. A company with a current name under objection (GDPR art. 21) returns the same 404 as an unknown date, not billed; the year's entity name under objection is served null and counted in ecartes.opposition (block partial in provenance). Paid via x402 ($0.05 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

company_number.description: Companies House company number, 8 characters incl. leading zeros, e.g. 00095407 or SC123456

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_uk_company_accounts

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: UK annual accounts (iXBRL)
